<issue>
GPX extensions missing attributes and child elements in XML output

#### Description

When serializing GPX files with extensions to XML, the extension elements are missing their attributes and child elements. Only the opening and closing tags with text content are preserved.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import gpxpy

# Parse a GPX file with Garmin extensions
gpx_content = '''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx creator="Garmin Connect" version="1.1"
  xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1 http://www.topografix.com/GPX/11.xsd"
  xmlns:ns3="http://www.garmin.com/xmlschemas/TrackPointExtension/v1"
  xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1"
  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:ns2="http://www.garmin.com/xmlschemas/GpxExtensions/v3">
  <metadata>
  </metadata>
  <trk>
    <name>Foo Bar</name>
    <type>running</type>
    <trkseg>
      <trkpt lat="51.43788929097354412078857421875" lon="6.617012657225131988525390625">
        <ele>23.6000003814697265625</ele>
        <time>2018-02-21T14:30:50.000Z</time>
        <extensions>
          <ns3:TrackPointExtension>
            <ns3:hr>125</ns3:hr>
            <ns3:cad>75</ns3:cad>
          </ns3:TrackPointExtension>
        </extensions>
      </trkpt>
    </trkseg>
  </trk>
</gpx>'''

gpx = gpxpy.parse(gpx_content)
xml_output = gpx.to_xml()
print(xml_output)

# Check if extensions are properly serialized
print('<ns3:hr>125</ns3:hr>' in xml_output)  # Should be True but returns False
print('<ns3:cad>75</ns3:cad>' in xml_output)  # Should be True but returns False
```

The extension elements lose their child elements and attributes when converted back to XML. This breaks round-trip parsing where you expect to get the same structure after parsing and serializing.
</issue>
